_meta.description: Rules for booking awards for a family: child and lap-infant pricing, booking for people other than the account holder (beneficiaries), and household pooling. Use whenever the party has more than one traveller or includes a child.
_meta.confidence_levels: VERIFIED = primary source + 1 secondary; LIKELY = single primary or multiple secondaries agree; UNVERIFIED = single secondary or dated source.
_meta.age_rule: Infant = under 2 on the travel date (LATAM: under 2 on every segment, including the return). Child = 2-11. Compute age from the birth month for each segment date.

flying_blue.child_2_11: 25% off the adult award, any cabin, including partners. Not on Promo Rewards. May now require the child to be in a Flying Blue Family pool.
flying_blue.infant: Book through Flying Blue customer service.

iberia.child_2_11: No published Avios child rate found. Cash child discounts exist and vary by fare. Check the booking engine fare breakdown.
iberia.infant: 10% of the adult Avios price, economy only. Add infants through the Iberia app (website blocks it).

latam_pass.child_2_11: Full miles assumed (no child discount found).
latam_pass.infant: About 10% of the adult miles on international flights, plus taxes.

smiles.child_2_11: No child discount on award redemptions.
smiles.infant: Infant fee paid in cash, not miles.

azul.child_2_11: No child discount on award redemptions (older source).

latam_pass.limit: 24-25 distinct third parties per rolling 12 months (sources disagree on whether each ticket counts).

smiles.limit: 25 people per calendar year, resets 1 January.

azul.limit: Passenger must be on a pre-registered beneficiary list; 5-15 slots depending on tier (sources disagree).
azul.fee: R$ 69.90-189.90 when booking under 120 days out without the account holder on the reservation.

flying_blue.limit: Awards can be booked for anyone. Family pooling lets the family leader move members' miles into their account.

iberia.limit: Awards can be booked for registered beneficiaries; see data/avios-family.json for Family Accounts.

flying_blue_family.members: up to 8 (max 2 adults, up to 6 children)
flying_blue_family.notes: Leader can transfer members' miles to themselves. Linking the child may unlock the 25% child discount.

split_ticket_warning: When the 3 seats are split across programs on the same flight, each booking is separate: a schedule change or cancellation on one is not mirrored on the other, and seat assignment together is not guaranteed. Link the bookings with the airline after ticketing.
